title: Astraios: Parameter-Efficient Instruction Tuning Code Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2401.00788v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The high cost of full-parameter fine-tuning (FFT) of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to a series of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods. However, it remains unclear which methods provide the best cost-performance trade-off at different model scales. We introduce Astraios, a suite of 28 instruction-tuned OctoCoder models using 7 tuning methods and 4 model sizes up to 16 billion parameters. Through investigations across 5 tasks and 8 different datasets encompassing both code comprehension and code generation tasks, we find that FFT generally leads to the best downstream performance across all scales, and PEFT methods differ significantly in their efficacy based on the model scale. LoRA usually offers the most favorable trade-off between cost and performance. translated_title: Astraios：参数高效的指令微调代码大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）全参数微调（FFT）的高昂成本催生了一系列参数高效微调（PEFT）方法。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些方法在不同模型规模下能够提供最佳的成本-性能权衡。我们提出了Astraios，这是一个包含28个经过指令微调的OctoCoder模型的套件，采用了7种微调方法和4种模型规模，最大参数量达160亿。通过对涵盖代码理解和代码生成任务的5个任务和8个不同数据集的调查研究，我们发现FFT通常在所有模型规模下都能带来最佳的下游性能，而PEFT方法的有效性则随模型规模的不同而有显著差异。LoRA通常在成本和性能之间提供最有利的权衡。进一步研究这些方法对模型鲁棒性和代码安全性的影响后发现，较大的模型往往表现出较低的鲁棒性。
tldr: 该论文提出了Astraios套件——包含28个采用7种微调方法、4种规模（最大160亿参数）指令微调的代码大语言模型，系统研究发现全参数微调总体性能最佳，LoRA通常提供最有利的成本-性能权衡，且PEFT方法的效果随模型规模显著变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Astraios, a suite of 28 instruction-tuned code LLMs spanning 7 tuning methods and 4 model sizes up to 16B parameters, finding that full-parameter fine-tuning generally yields the best downstream performance, LoRA usually offers the most favorable cost-performance trade-off, and PEFT efficacy varies significantly with model scale.
